channel.title: AI Threat Watch: UA
channel.description: Verified case files located in UA.

item.title: [HIGH] Sandworm-linked cluster used Gemini to write password-spraying scripts against Ukraine
item.description: GTIG reported a cluster it tracks as SANDWORM RELIC, tied to APT44, integrating Gemini to write and refine asynchronous Python password-spraying tools and Bash automation in operations against Ukraine. Target: Ukrainian organisations. UA. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Russia-nexus CANFAIL and LONGSTREAM malware pad code with LLM filler to fool analysts
item.description: GTIG found two Russia-nexus families aimed at Ukraine whose LLM-generated decoy logic, including comments labelling blocks as filler and 32 daylight-saving checks, is designed to make scripts look benign to reviewers. Target: Ukrainian organisations. UA. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] LameHug: APT28-linked malware queries Qwen LLM to generate commands
item.description: CERT-UA reported phishing that delivered LameHug, a Python stealer using Qwen 2.5-Coder via Hugging Face's API to craft recon and theft commands, attributed to APT28 with moderate confidence. Target: Ukrainian government bodies. UA. Verification: confirmed.
